verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only individual user controls: revoking Google access, opting out of model training, and deleting indexed data from the personal 'Workspace' settings. Nothing documents an organization workspace in which a team admin can manage members, assign permissions, or set org-wide data policies. Per-user privacy settings are an adjacent feature and earn no credit toward this team-admin story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
